criteria.criterion: athena.toml has a [landing] table with merge_via_rest = true, preceded by a comment giving the reason.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: athena.toml now ends with a two-line comment (Athena asks the host to merge once checks are green, so `athena land --pr` finishes without a manual merge step; red or pending checks never merge), then `[landing]` and `merge_via_rest = true`. The comment matches the code: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs:484 merges only when `job.merge_via_rest && seen == Checks::Green`.

criteria.criterion: The test in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs derives a stripped config with no [landing] table from REPO_CONFIG and asserts merge_via_rest is false on it.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: the test builds `stripped` with `REPO_CONFIG.split_once("[landing]")`, asserts that `stripped` does not contain `merge_via_rest`, and asserts `!Config::parse(stripped).unwrap().landing.merge_via_rest`. The [landing] table is the last thing in athena.toml, so the part before it is a complete config. The explicit-true and empty-table assertions stay, now built on `stripped`.

criteria.criterion: The test asserts that parsing this repository's athena.toml gives merge_via_rest == true, and no longer asserts that REPO_CONFIG lacks [landing].
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: `assert!(!REPO_CONFIG.contains("[landing]"))` is removed, and `assert!(Config::parse(REPO_CONFIG).unwrap().landing.merge_via_rest)` is added.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry under '## [Unreleased]' in a '### Changed' subsection (not 'Added') describing the setting change; no other CHANGELOG lines change.
criteria.evidence: A Grep of the headings shows `## [Unreleased]` at line 8 and the next release, `## [0.1.0]`, at line 284, so the `### Changed` at line 58 is inside Unreleased. The reading's assumption that it belonged to a released section was wrong. The producer added one 3-line bullet under that existing heading and changed no other lines (3 insertions, 0 deletions).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on and the other tests pass.
criteria.evidence: Ran both: `config::tests::rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on ... ok`, and the full crate run gave 45 passed, 0 failed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both clean.
criteria.evidence: Ran both. Clippy finished with no warnings. `cargo fmt --check` printed nothing and the command chain reported no error. Athena's own `-D warnings` clippy run and its fmt check also passed.

criteria.criterion: No files other than athena.toml, crates/athena-data/src/config.rs and CHANGELOG.md change.
criteria.evidence: The stat lists only CHANGELOG.md, athena.toml and crates/athena-data/src/config.rs.

request_reading_mismatch: One small factual slip in the reading, which did not affect the result. It assumed the Unreleased section had no '### Changed' heading. In fact the one at line 58 is inside Unreleased (the 0.1.0 release starts at line 284). The producer correctly added the entry under that existing heading instead of creating a second one.
summary: The change does what was asked. athena.toml now ends with a [landing] table that sets merge_via_rest = true, with a comment explaining why; the comment matches the code, which merges only when checks are green. The config.rs test now checks the default on a copy of athena.toml with the [landing] table removed, keeps the explicit-true and empty-table checks, and asserts that this repository's config turns the merge on. That fixes the root cause: the test had pinned the repository's live setting instead of the default. CHANGELOG.md gains one entry under the existing Unreleased 'Changed' heading. Only the three expected files change. I ran `cargo test -p athena-data` (45 passed, including the target test), `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`, and all were clean.
